items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Baby, good drummer. Good drummer. beautiful drummer.

ctx.x: No way, even guys say come on let's go hear so and so. I heard them all. I visit guys. I never evade them, I always visit guys I like, because we hung out together. We hung out. I know they could play or people wouldn't go hear them. But we got on the bandstand, we was gone.
Was there much -- what did you think of drummers like Baby Dodds, Zutty Singleton, did you hear him?

Zutty, well, Zutty was one of my best pals. Good drummer. Baby, good drummer. Good drummer. beautiful drummer. Sidney Catlett, /Chick Webb, beautiful drumer. Kaiser was a beautiful drummer. He fitted Fletcher's band like a glove. He used to tell everybody he was my brother.
